subject: suite-chaos
origin: ## 6. E2E Test Strategy › #### Scenario: E5 — snapshot corruption → replay recovery
text:
- **Chaos suite** (`chaos_*.rs`, sysinfo 0.39.6 + std):
  - torn append: `skipped.torn_lines` goes up by 1, and the next append starts on a fresh line. As landed (`tests/chaos_torn_append.rs`, chunk 2026-10-10-self-healing-state): the wrapper is stopped and its log shortened with `File::set_len(len − k)`, in place of a kill mid-append with `Process::kill_with(Signal::Kill)` (the file on disk is the same, and a killed instrumented process can leave a short coverage profile, as measured at chunk 2026-10-07-a-send-ending-in-a-newline-is-confirmed); the count is read through the product reader, 1 before the heal and 1 after it; the next start's first record starts on a fresh line with every earlier byte unchanged; and the wrapper's role file holds one `state-recovered` line, which the case holds to the diag-line schema itself, because a local run removes its test homes. The `skipped.torn_lines` reading on `list --json` landed at chunk 2026-10-11-the-board-viola-list: the case reads `torn_lines` 1 through `viola list --json` and starts from `stamped_home`
  - the no-EOF fake mode: the wrapper detects exit on the handle (`exit_source:"handle-wait"`). Whether the output outlives the session leader is OS-specific, as measured in CI runs 36165685381 / 36166907442: natively on ConPTY; on Linux only while the `--exit-no-eof` holder runs in its own process group (a holder in the leader's foreground group dies by SIGHUP when the leader exits); on macOS the output ends at the leader's exit even with the holder alive in its own group. The held-output half is therefore asserted on Windows + Linux only, and on macOS exit on the handle is shown by the handle wait alone (`tests/tui_pty_seam.rs`) and a `session-end` record is logged
  - endpoint vanishes during `wait`: exit 21
  - SIGSTOP the wrapper (Unix) for over 5 s: `liveness:"stale"`, and a new `run` exits 1; after SIGKILL: omitted as gone
  - forced vt100 panic mode (`chaos_feed_panic_refuses_send_and_keeps_passthrough`, `tests/chaos_feed_panic.rs`): `send` exits 13 with `input-not-ready`, human passthrough still reaches the receipt (a typed key reaches the child, nothing is typed), and the outer terminal shows the child's own panicking bytes (`e4 b8 ad`, Unix) and none of `panic`, `parse-rejected`, `vt100`, `unable`, `hint:` (every OS)
    - On Windows the case asserts the literals' absence only: ConPTY re-renders the child's output, and a wide character on a 1-column screen has no guaranteed rendering, so the byte oracle for the panicking wide character is owed to the route entry "Windows-only live measurements".
  - forward-compat lines (`chaos_forward_compat.rs`, multi-version-compat trigger). Append two lines to a product-written `events.ndjson`, under the §7 exception for files the product already wrote: one with an unknown `kind`, and one known-kind line with an extra unknown field. Then:
    - `list --json` exits 0
    - `skipped.unknown_kinds` and `skipped.unknown_fields` each rise by exactly 1
    - the known-kind line still counts toward item state
    - `wait --after <offset before the append>` does not wake on the unknown-kind line
    - As landed (chunk 2026-10-11-the-board-viola-list), the `list --json` leg alone: `chaos_lines_of_a_newer_build_are_counted_and_the_board_still_reads` (`tests/chaos_forward_compat.rs`, from `stamped_home`) appends the two lines and reads `list --json` exit 0 with `skipped.unknown_kinds` 1 and `skipped.unknown_fields` 1. The item-state and `wait` bullets are not asserted by this case.
  - `.cmd` child (`#[cfg(windows)]`): `run` exits 1 — landed in `tests/cli_program_resolution.rs` (a `.cmd` and a `.bat` child each exit 1 with no child spawned, `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:1, detail:"batch-script-child"}`, exactly the two fixed `unable:`/`hint:` stderr lines; the same binary proves `claude.cmd` → sibling `claude.exe` resolution)
  - snapshot replay (`tests/chaos_snapshot_replay.rs`): E5 steps 1–3, a start over an unreadable or newer `snapshot.json` that `run`'s collision check reads through `read_snapshot_or_replay` (Scenario E5)

origin: ## 6. E2E Test Strategy › #### Scenario: E5 — snapshot corruption → replay recovery
text:
- **Property suite** (proptest 1.11.0, `cases: 512`):
  - `validate_paste_text` over `any::<String>()` plus injected C0/C1 chars (landed at `cases: 512`, chunk 2026-10-04-confirmed-send-with-cl-1-records)
  - ndjson framing at `MAX_FRAME` ± 1
  - the hook stdin parser (`viola_agent_claude::hook::normalise` over arbitrary bytes; landed at `cases: 512` with `crates/viola-agent-claude/proptest-regressions/hook.txt` committed); the statusline reader (`viola_agent_claude::statusline::reading` over arbitrary JSON and `resets_at`; landed at `cases: 512` with `crates/viola-agent-claude/proptest-regressions/statusline.txt` committed, chunk 2026-10-10-statusline-pass-through; its strategy draws whole seconds across the date range, because as first written it stayed green on a stub)
  - the `claude agents --json` parser over arbitrary JSON (landed at `cases: 512`, the `agents.rs` `proptest!`, chunk 2026-10-16-unwrapped-sessions-on-the-board, with `crates/viola-agent-claude/proptest-regressions/agents.txt` committed; its oracle compares a row against the input re-parsed from its bytes, because a float does not round-trip through serde_json text)
  - the vt100 feed under `catch_unwind` over arbitrary bytes (landed at `cases: 512`: `screen::tests::feed_prop_a_caught_panic_poisons_until_resize`, sizes 1–30 × 1–120 with interleaved resizes; after a caught panic the poisoned model reads `input-not-ready` and drops further bytes)
  - `prompt-submitted` normalisation round-trip (`<pasted_content` / `<\pasted_content`; landed at `cases: 512`)

  cargo-fuzz 0.13.2 targets live in the separate `fuzz/` cargo workspace and use shared `arbitrary` 1.4.2 inputs. The first is `viola_name` (`ViolaName::try_new` against an independent literal oracle, 18 synthetic seeds): a seventh, pre-parser seed target, so the pipeline runs with a real consumer. The six parser targets join as their parsers land: `channel_frame` (7 synthetic seeds), `hook_stdin` (the `viola hook` stdin parser and, since chunk 2026-10-10-statusline-pass-through, the statusline reader; 12 synthetic seeds by `ls fuzz/corpus/hook_stdin | wc -l`, the two added `statusline-epoch` and `statusline-absent`) and `vt100_feed` (the vt100 feed under `catch_unwind`, 6 synthetic seeds: three measured panic sizes and three 24×80 lines) and `paste_text` (`validate_paste_text` against an independent per-char oracle over lossy UTF-8, 8 synthetic seeds, kept byte-exact by `.gitattributes` `fuzz/corpus/paste_text/** binary`) and `claude_agents_json` (`agents::parse` over arbitrary bytes, chunk 2026-10-16-unwrapped-sessions-on-the-board; 6 synthetic seeds, `background-row`, `control-session-id`, `deep-array`, `empty-array`, `measured-row` and `non-array`, kept byte-exact by `.gitattributes` `fuzz/corpus/claude_agents_json/** binary`) have joined. `vt100_feed` installs a silent panic hook once before its first feed: libfuzzer-sys's own hook aborts on every panic, a caught one included, while a panic escaping the target's catch still aborts through libfuzzer-sys's catch around the body (as measured at chunk 2026-10-04-readiness-gate-and-timing-constants: the 24×1 wide-char seed replays green with the hook and crashes without it).

subject: suite-contract
origin: ## 6. E2E Test Strategy › #### Scenario: E5 — snapshot corruption → replay recovery
text:
- **Contract suite** (`contract_*.rs`):
  - For each `fixtures/claude/<ver>/` set (walked at run time; an empty walk fails), the fake agent's print-mode hook sequence and payloads (captured in the receipt) must equal the recorded fixture order and payloads: the `hook` events equal the spine literal SessionStart → UserPromptSubmit → Stop → SessionEnd, each `ran:true` with `exit_code:0`, and each `stdin_hex` decodes to that event's recorded fixture bytes exactly — compared byte for byte against the recorded fixture files, never an insta snapshot (`tests/contract_fake_agent_drift.rs`; its `drift` comparator names a planted order swap and a planted one-byte fixture difference).
  - The forwarded `annotations` in the question answer path are asserted explicitly (S8) — with "Dialog answers by dialog_id", where the question answer path and its fixtures land.
  - jsonschema checks every fixture against the tolerant parser schema: unknown fields allowed, closed enums required.
  - `tests/contract_content_hash.rs` pins the pinned-exe content hash (§1 "SHA-256 16-hex re-hash") to its library, `sha2` (a root dev-dependency): `sha256_published_vector_matches_digest` over the three FIPS 180-2 vectors and `sha256_truncated_to_eight_bytes_yields_sixteen_hex` over the 8-byte / 16-hex truncation, literal oracles, on all three OSes.
  - `tests/contract_bounded_readers.rs` (a `contract_` binary in the E2E layer, `run --e2e`) holds two literal tables, never the product's own list: `BOUNDARIES`, one row per external reader naming its bounded read, its cap, depth and type rule and the existing test that witnesses it, and `EXCEPTIONS`, the reads of viola's own executable (`checked_exe`, `pin_exe`), no external input. `boundaries_each_name_a_bounded_read_that_stands` holds each row's read to its file and its witness to a defined test, and each exception to a read that stands; its other tests are `product_readers_are_each_bounded_or_named`, `census_finds_an_unbounded_read_and_passes_a_bounded_one` and `serde_json_unbounded_depth_is_banned_in_deny_toml` (the `deny.toml` feature ban read).
    - The census (`product_readers_are_each_bounded_or_named`, its file carrying the `andromeda:walks-tree` token) walks the product source roots, comments, strings and test items left out: a reader call passes when a `take(` stands in its own statement up to the call, or when an `EXCEPTIONS` needle stands on the call's whole source line; its self-check `census_finds_an_unbounded_read_and_passes_a_bounded_one` reads a planted unbounded read as a hit; with the `replace_private_shared` compare bound undone it reads red at exactly `crates/viola-state/src/fs.rs:354` (as measured at `viola-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-27-bounded-inputs-at-every-boundary/evidence/controls.md`).
  - `tests/contract_error_bodies.rs` (a `contract_` binary, `run --e2e`) is the error-body enumeration: the tables `CLI_DOCUMENTS`, `MCP_RESULTS`, `MCP_FIELD_WORDS`, `CHANNEL_FAULTS`, `CHANNEL_METHODS`, `NOT_ERROR_BODIES` and `PLUMBING` over `PRODUCT_ROOTS`, its file carrying the `andromeda:walks-tree` token.
    - Its guards: `error_bodies_each_name_a_writer_and_a_witness_that_stand`, `channel_faults_are_the_seven_literal_bodies`, `product_error_writers_are_each_named` and `thiserror_messages_interpolate_nothing`, with the census self-check `census_finds_an_unnamed_writer_and_an_interpolated_message`.
